form_id_format: uppercase hyphen-separated tokens containing at least one zero-padded four-digit numeric token
trunks: Collection landing pages keep their collection IDs and have no parent.
satellites: Content records keep their collection as the structural parent; semantic relationships are separate Boris relations.
allocation: Existing form codes are preserved when possible, numeric segments are normalized to four digits, and missing form IDs are allocated from the next unused collection prefix.
immutability: IDs are never silently renumbered or reused. The migration map records the prior slug-derived identity.
